punchline: The Fed supplied the room; rival firms supplied the money: fourteen firms, about 3.6 billion dollars.
thirty_sec: On 23 September 1998, in facilities provided by the New York Fed, fourteen firms put about 3.6 billion dollars into LTCM and took 90 percent of the portfolio, after a rival buy-out offer lapsed at the 12:30 deadline.
question: Whom could you put around one table this week so everyone sees the same numbers?
key_contrast: Not Fed money but the firms' own arithmetic made the deal.
